images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: professionally retouched real-world product-in-use photograph for a premium product website, portrait 3:4.
Primary request: Upgrade the supplied phone photo into an elegant professional outdoor product photograph while keeping this EXACT installation, product identity and mechanically correct orientation.
Invariants: one vivid orange 3D-printed masonry line holder clamped around the SAME upright rusty ribbed steel reinforcing rod beside dark charcoal paving-edge blocks and evergreen foliage. Preserve the product's silhouette, proportions, open spaces, toothed guide plate, inclined projecting supports, printed texture and fine teeth. In this working installation the BLACK handwheel and SILVER clamping screw extend HORIZONTALLY to the LEFT behind the orange body; they must NOT be moved to the top or turned vertical. The pink/red masonry line remains visibly engaged with the real guide teeth and extends taut to the right. Keep the connection points, line path, installation height and correct relationship to the rod, curb and blocks. Preserve weathered steel and material realism.
Professional finish: slightly tighter, thoughtfully composed framing so the orange tool is clearly the main subject, all of the tool and useful rod context visible. Soft directional daylight with subtle warm highlights, balanced exposure, accurate orange color, restrained contrast, excellent crisp microdetail on the product and thread. Clean neutral charcoal blocks and concrete retain realistic texture. Reduce distracting stains, loose debris, small weeds and patchy snow/white residue on the surrounding ground, while preserving believable sand/gravel and the same location. Evergreen background softly out of focus, gently quieter and less saturated; tool and its mounting in sharp focus. Natural full-frame-camera photographic depth, polished editorial quality, not a fake studio rendering or heavily cinematic grade.
Avoid: new parts, changed product geometry, simplified teeth, bending the rod, a vertical screw, gold cord (keep the actual pink/red working line), replacement scenery, added logos or text, people, hands, watermarks, dramatic fake sun rays, exaggerated bokeh, plastic-looking CGI. Do not add products.
Camera: preserve the first photo's relatively low front three-quarter view of the orange front guide plate, rod and wall junction. Tighten framing moderately around the tool, reducing empty ground while retaining the surroundings and taut line running right.
